limitations: Independent local native examples are not joined to neighbouring terrain and are not adopted into the global renderer
Deferred original siting, complete agricultural access and neighbouring road connections remain unresolved
Sampled land footprints do not secure rights, annual food yield, drinking water or flood recurrence
Native terrain spacing is 55.30x76.35m; smaller terrain features, soil and foundation strength remain ungenerated/unverified
PC GPU globe, endurance, packaging/release and human visual/interaction acceptance were not run
roadmap: L0 statistical distribution -> conservative L1 budgets -> L2 fixed candidate handoff -> bounded native local materialization/survey/persistent records and PC inspection. Next deferred siting, agricultural access, neighbouring terrain/roads and global runtime adoption
